name: Reed Chime
desc: A woven-reed bell-lantern. Its ring asks a wild kin to join your troupe.

name: Brass Chime
desc: A brass bell-lantern with a truer ring. Better odds than a Reed Chime.

name: Silver Chime
desc: An engraved silver chime whose note carries far. Strong odds.

name: Crown Chime
desc: A crown-topped master chime. Few kin can resist its call.

name: Honey Salve
desc: Restores 20 HP to one kin.

name: Clover Salve
desc: Restores 60 HP to one kin.

name: Ember-root Salve
desc: Restores 150 HP to one kin.

name: Hearth Balm
desc: Fully restores one kin's HP.

name: Cooling Moss
desc: Soothes a burn.

name: Bitterleaf
desc: Draws out poison.

name: Loosening Oil
desc: Eases paralysis.

name: Waking Bell
desc: A tiny bell that rouses a sleeping kin.

name: Warm Wrap
desc: Thaws frostbite.

name: Tuning Tonic
desc: Cures any lingering condition, including dizziness.

name: Kindling Spark
desc: Revives a quiet kin with half its HP.

name: Rekindle Draught
desc: Revives a quiet kin with full HP.

name: Rosin Cake
desc: Restores 10 charges to one move.

name: Rosin Block
desc: Fully restores every move charge of one kin.

name: Hush Incense
desc: Wild kin keep their distance for 200 m of walking.

name: Deep Hush Incense
desc: Wild kin keep their distance for 400 m of walking.

name: Homeward Thread
desc: Follow the thread back to the last Hearthrest from wild areas.

name: Dawn Prism
desc: A prism that lets a stage-2 lumen kin reach its crescendo.

name: Etude: Heat Ribbon
desc: A wax cylinder that teaches Heat Ribbon. Reusable.

name: Moss Keynote
desc: A tuning-fork crystal earned at a Cadence Hall (1 of 6).

name: Slate Keynote
desc: A tuning-fork crystal earned at a Cadence Hall (2 of 6).

name: Mere Keynote
desc: A tuning-fork crystal earned at a Cadence Hall (3 of 6).

name: Tuning Ledger
desc: Your leather-bound Tuner's ledger: journal, map and Keynotes.

name: Fallen Windchime
desc: A dented little windchime, still humming faintly. Someone in Larkhollow is missing it.

name: Glowcap
desc: A mushroom cap that glows with stored song. Hollow trees drink it gladly.

name: Bell Clapper
desc: A brass clapper shaken loose from one of Knellstone's bells.

name: Crystal Sample
desc: A chip of singing crystal from the Undertone. The survey guild wants these.

name: Surveyor's Pin
desc: A small pin that marks you as a friend of the survey guild.
